valuation.basis: current market cap vs the newest period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the income statement and the balance sheet share no period (income newest FY2025, balance newest HY 2026), so earnings, book value and the market cap cannot be put on one period. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
